name: grass
summary: Meadow: the ground itself, not the clumps standing in it. Blades laid over soil, seen from above and from a long way off.
why: Roughness 0.92, the roughest thing in the library. Grass scatters in every direction and
has no highlight at any angle a player ever sees it from - the one surface where a
specular response is purely a mistake.
Depth 0.18, which is far less than the art might suggest. The luminance swing on
TileGrass01 is large, but most of it is colour - lighter and darker patches of the same
flat ground - rather than height. Grass blades are millimetres proud. At 0.4 the meadow
came out looking like moss on a boulder.
Roughness range 0.10, which is the damp hollow against the dry tuft. It is the material
in this library with the most honest claim to varying: a field really is patchily wet.
Cast grain rather than brushed. A meadow has no direction - it is not mown.
